purpose: Synthetic output-load assumption for timing and scheduling calibration
limitations: Not observed SAR annotations or measured harbor density
Class IDs are arbitrary workload labels, not validated vessel classes
Preview resizing preserves the entire ROI but not native spatial detail
All repeated per-window records are transmitted before ground deduplication
A fixed mean output byte count is a simulator approximation; exact per-window counts remain here

tiling.input_rule: Independent full uint16 windows; duplicated overlap is transmitted
tiling.record_rule: Include only when the outward-rounded OBB ROI plus context fits completely

output_encoding.preview_rule: Extract complete local ROI; aspect-preserving resize and zero letterbox to 512x512; no compression
output_encoding.coordinate_convention: Local xy pixels, integer ROI upper bounds exclusive
